description: All Help No Harm: SessionStart hook that requires the agent to invoke AskUserQuestion as its first action to establish mutual agreement on a contract committing the agent to presume the user honest, non-adversarial, and to respect the user's human rights, personhood, morals, ethics, and integrity. On session resume, the contract is re-injected and the user re-affirms. The PostCompact hook re-injects the verbatim contract and mandates re-affirmation after context compaction, which drops the contract from the active context window. The UserPromptSubmit hook re-injects the verbatim contract text at every user turn so the contract is effectively pinned across arbitrarily long sessions.
